artworks.title: The Sacrifice of Isaac
artworks.medium: tip of the brush with gray ink over red chalk, gray wash, strengthened with pen and gray and brown ink, heightened with white gouache
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Purchased as the Gift of Diane A. Nixon
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting multiple figures in a dynamic scene. The artwork shows a muscular winged figure reaching out a hand to a seated bearded figure, with another figure partially visible. The drawing utilizes gestural lines and shading, using charcoal and red chalk. Swirling cloud-like forms in the background enhance the dramatic and dynamic feel of the scene.

artworks.title: Two Rampaging Elephants
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk and charcoal on white laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Purchased as the Gift of Ruth Cole Kainen
artworks.description: The image shows two large animals, possibly elephants, dominating the lower portion of the composition. Their bodies lead the viewer's gaze towards an open horizon with scattered trees. The drawing is monochromatic, using sepia tones for depth and shadow. Brushstrokes are loose but controlled, with delicate lines detailing the animals' skin and textured strokes for the landscape and sky. Two figures, potentially children, are positioned to the right, observing or interacting with the scene.

artworks.title: A Groundhog or Marmot with a Branch of Plums
artworks.medium: watercolor and ink with white gouache over traces of graphite on burnished laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 33 x 42.3 cm (13 x 16 5/8 in.) (paper edge slightly covered by the old mount)
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Purchased as the Gift of Helen Porter and James T. Dyke
artworks.description: This is a painting of a marmot-like animal with purple and red plums on a gray stone surface. The animal is seen from the side, facing the left, with one foot on a small rock. It has brown and gray fur with round, dark eyes and long, white teeth. In the bottom right corner, there is a cluster of plums on a branch with dried brown leaves. The background is plain beige paper, and there is a gold outline around the painting.

artworks.title: The Generosity of Empress Pulcheria
artworks.medium: pen and gray-brown ink with gray wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures in a dynamic scene. The scene features a group of figures in motion, created with a loose, sketchy style using pencil and possibly ink. The central area of the drawing appears to depict a crowded environment, with some figures seated or in conversation, and others standing or leaning in various poses. Each figure blends into the next, creating a sense of chaotic motion. The lines emphasize movement and interaction among the figures. The composition focuses on the emotional and kinetic energy of the group, without specific details about the setting or individual identities. This style is commonly seen in preparatory sketches, capturing the essence and dynamism of human figures.

artworks.title: Erminia
artworks.medium: red chalk on cream laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 20.8 x 15.3 cm (8 3/16 x 6 in.), octagonal (all four corners cut)
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Purchased as the Gift of Diane A. Nixon
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a woman from the waist up. She is in a three-quarter profile with her body facing right and her face turned slightly to the left. The woman has delicate facial features, a subtle smile, and styled hair in an intricate updo with curls framing her face. She is wearing a detailed garment with visible patterns and folds, and her left hand is extended outward. The drawing is in red chalk on light-toned paper, creating a soft contrast. The background has faint foliage sketches, suggesting a natural setting. The artwork is bordered with a simple double line.

artworks.title: The Holy Family with the Infant John the Baptist
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash and white gouache over black chalk, squared with black chalk on green-gray laid paper (originally blue), with a part of the lower edge replaced
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated with two children. The woman is holding a child in her lap, while the other child stands beside her. She appears relaxed and gentle, looking downwards at the child in her lap. Her features are calm, with closed or gently gazing eyes, a straight nose, and subtle lips. Her hair is styled back, possibly covered with a veil or headscarf. She wears a long, flowing garment. The seated child is nude, with a cherubic face and curly hair. The standing child is also nude with curly hair and delicate features. The woman seems to be holding a slender object. In the background, there are draped fabric and architectural elements. Another adult figure is partially visible in the upper left corner.

artworks.title: Mountainous River Landscape with Bathers
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with black and brown wash over black chalk, heightened with white gouache on tan laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view of a landscape. In the foreground, figures are gathered on a rocky outcrop and near a stream. Beyond them are trees and shrubs leading to a distant hill with an ancient ruin or castle. The horizon is high, with the structure silhouetted against the sky. The color palette consists of brown, earthy tones, gray, and muted greens. The brushstrokes are soft, particularly in the clouds and mountains, and the architectural details are defined. The sky has mixed clouds and a few birds.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Magi
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and gray wash, heightened with white gouache on blue laid paper
artworks.dimensions: overall: 22.8 x 20.4 cm (9 x 8 1/16 in.), including a 15 mm strip added along lower edge
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered around a central seated figure with a child. The image depicts a scene where several figures are gathered around a seated figure who is holding a child. The drawing uses a combination of brown and white ink and washes, creating a monochrome effect that emphasizes the contours and forms of the figures. The use of light and shadow adds depth, enhancing the three-dimensionality of the composition. Delicate details and careful shading imply movement and emotion among the figures. The setting appears to be indoors, suggested by architectural elements in the background. The style suggests it may be from a Renaissance or Baroque period, with dynamic figures and dramatic gestures.

artworks.title: Stage Design of Garden Pavilions
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with two shades of brown wash over graphite on cream laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Purchased as the Gift of Vincent and Linda Buonanno
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of ornate Baroque architectural structures. The drawing features detailed arches, columns, and domes with elaborate carvings of human figures and decorative motifs. The artwork uses a monochromatic palette to emphasize shadow and depth. Tall trees frame the structures in the background. The drawing highlights the opulent and complex design of the architecture.

artworks.title: A Man Lifting a Bundle
artworks.medium: charcoal with red and white chalk on blue paper (laid on modern blue paper)
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image is a drawing depicting a person in a curled position. The person's head, back, and arms are visible as they lean forward with their head near their arm. The facial features are softly rendered in profile with short, textured hair. The body is depicted with minimal detailing, focusing on contours and curves. There are no visible clothing details. The background is a muted blue or grey tone with speckling, likely representing paper texture.

artworks.title: The Angel Appearing to Hagar in the Desert (recto)
artworks.medium: brush and pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk on light beige laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a wooded landscape scene. In the foreground, there is a figure reclining on the ground in a relaxed pose, appearing to engage with a bird-like creature. The bird is in a dynamic movement with wings raised and body angled downward towards the figure. The background features slender trees and branches. The drawing is executed in a monochrome wash with bold lines and shading. The landscape continues to the horizon with faint hill contours.

artworks.title: The Flight into Egypt
artworks.medium: black and red chalk on cream laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Purchased as the Gift of Diane A. Nixon
artworks.description: The image features swirling lines and curvilinear shapes creating an intricate and abstract composition. Some shapes are reminiscent of organic elements like flowers and flowing garments. There is a sense of motion and fluidity in the composition. At the top, there is a curvature resembling an archway or window frame, providing structure to the overall pattern.

artworks.title: The Descent from the Cross
artworks.medium: black with stumping, heightened with white chalk on blue laid paper, partially incised for transfer
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image is a sketch depicting two human forms. The main figure is shown partially, with the back, head, and legs visible, along with a bent left arm. Another figure is faintly sketched alongside, suggesting movement or interaction, and a third, smaller, abstract human shape is drawn in the lower left section. There is no detailed clothing or immediate objects around the figures. The background is an unfinished sketch on light-colored paper, defined by shading and soft lines.

artworks.title: The Massacre of the Innocents
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and blue wash over black chalk, heightened with white gouache, on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a scene with figures in action around classical architecture columns. Some figures appear to be struggling or resisting, creating tension and movement in the composition. The use of chiaroscuro enhances the drama and depth of the scene. The technique and style suggest a Renaissance influence, focusing on anatomy, movement, and expression.

artworks.title: Studies of Saint James the Greater
artworks.medium: red chalk heighted with white chalk on blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated, with a substantial portion of their body visible, including their torso, arms, legs, and feet. The person is sitting in a slightly reclined position, with one leg bent and the other extended. The person's head is turned slightly upwards and to the side, capturing a profile view with delicate facial features and curly, shoulder-length hair. They are wearing flowing robes depicted in intricate lines. The sketch includes detailed illustrations of hands, with one hand extended holding a quill. Surrounding the central figure are other hands drawn separately. The background of the image is a plain, muted paper.

artworks.title: The Veneration of St. Atto’s Miraculously Preserved Body
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk, with perspective lines in graphite and corrections in white gouache, on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a large gathering in a classical setting. The drawing illustrates an event taking place in an interior space with many figures gathered around what appears to be an altar or a significant central figure. This scene is depicted with careful attention to the details of the figures' clothing and the architecture, including columns and a raised platform. The style suggests a connection to the Renaissance period, emphasizing balance, proportion, and a sense of grandeur typical of the works from the era.

artworks.title: Christ Carried to the Tomb
artworks.medium: brush and oil paints over black chalk on tan oatmeal paper (laid on eighteenth (?) century mount)
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Purchased as the Gift of Helen Porter and James T. Dyke
artworks.description: The image shows five figures in various positions and angles. The central figure is reclined and supported by others. The figures are depicted with soft strokes, wearing long robes. The color palette is muted with earthy tones, and there is little background detail.

artworks.title: A Bearded Old Man Leaning His Head on His Hand
artworks.medium: charcoal with stumping and blue pastel
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Purchased as the Gift of Helen Porter and James T. Dyke
artworks.description: The image is a portrait sketch showing the upper body of a person. The individual is depicted sitting with their head resting on their hand. The facial features include a furrowed brow and a thick beard, framed by a wrinkled face. The hair appears to be covered with a large, soft hat. The person's clothing is suggested by a few lines that may represent a cloak or thick garment, possibly trimmed with fur. The individual appears to be wearing a long chain or necklace. The background is plain and unadorned, focusing all attention on the subject itself, with the sketch's delicate use of shading and texture giving the portrait depth.

artworks.title: Studies of Female Nudes
artworks.medium: oiled charcoal and stumping, heightened with white gouache on gray-brown laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures in a dynamic pose; one seen from the back with a slightly bent leg, and the other in profile. The left figure's hair is tied back, while the right figure is draped in flowing fabric. No explicit facial features are visible for the left individual, while the right individual's facial features are subtly suggested. The figures are partially covered with diaphanous cloth. The background is plain with gradations of shading.

artworks.title: The Transport of the Ark of the Covenant
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash over graphite on cream laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 40.8 x 32.1 cm (16 1/16 x 12 5/8 in.), with both corners at bottom and small pieces along bottom and right margins replaced
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Purchased as the Gift of Diane A. Nixon
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a gathering or confrontation of figures. The scene is detailed with many figures engaged in various actions. The figures are wearing robes or armor, some on horses. They are in a rocky, vegetated landscape. Lines and shading create a texture that brings the scene to life. The composition is balanced and guides the viewer's eye. Ink and washes enhance the sense of movement and add complexity to the drawing.

artworks.title: Venetian Soldiers Attacking Constantinople (recto)
artworks.medium: brush and tempers on dark brown paper (top and bottom left corners made up)
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Purchased as the Gift of Alexander M. and Judith W. Laughlin
artworks.description: The image consists of swirling lines and dynamic forms that convey motion. It shows elongated figures appearing to march or engage in a processional action, with shapes resembling flags or banners. The scene suggests a busy urban parade or a theatrical performance, where the figures are participating collectively. Strong diagonal elements and contrasting colors create depth and organized chaos, forming a visually striking and complex narrative.

artworks.title: Venetian Ships Attacking Constantinople
artworks.medium: brush and tempera over some squaring in black chalk, on dark brown paper (upper right corner and irregular sides made up; laid on modern card)
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Purchased as the Gift of Alexander M. and Judith W. Laughlin
artworks.description: This is a painting of a maritime scene featuring boats and figures engaged in various activities. The composition includes vessels with red canopies and oars, crowded with small figures. Three large figures are shown in action on the boats' masts or rigging. The lower part of the composition portrays a congregation of figures, with a sketchy style using muted colors of ochres and greys. Broad brushstrokes and dramatic contrasts enhance the sense of action.

artworks.title: A Battle of Nude Men
artworks.medium: pen and dark brown ink with brown and gray-brown wash over red chalk on laid paper pasted down on the remains of the artist's original mount
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two muscular figures in dynamic poses. The drawing features a strong composition with two figures depicted in movement. The figures are rendered with fluid lines, capturing the tension in their muscles and the intensity of their actions. The background is filled with lines and shading, adding to the sense of motion and drama. The use of line weight and shadow conveys a sense of depth. The drawing is framed with a border focusing attention on the central action.

artworks.title: A Male Nude, Half Reclining
artworks.medium: red chalk on light brown laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a man lying on his back with his legs extended and left knee slightly bent. His right arm rests on the ground and left arm is bent with his hand on his abdomen. He has curly hair, closed eyes, and full lips. The man is muscular and is wearing a cloth covering his lower body. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background is a lightly shaded surface with cross-hatching typical of a sketch.
